notes: Colour: panorama exposure varies a lot; sampled medians are cream-yellow (#faeec5, clipped) where sunlit and grey-brown (#6b6252, #6c6251) in shade/overcast, hue 38-43 deg. Wall set to a warmer, darker buff #c4975f with pale stone #e0d0a8 bands; the brown-orange read of the integrator could not be confirmed on the Leidseplein front (it matches the 1927 canal wing, which stays dark brown). Window axes counted from ref-se-winter.jpg. Tower cap is pale stone with clock faces. Temporary cafe awnings are not modelled. Upper storeys of the SE front stand 1.2 m behind the ring line in the 3DBAG shell, windows sit on that plane. Gable silhouettes remain the 3DBAG roof planes. Roofline rework 2026-10-10: dormer gable axes t = 9.0, 15.9, 21.0, 26.8, 32.7 m along the Leidseplein front (frame of ring edge 58) are taken from the 3DBAG dormer gable walls (plane 2.0 m behind the ring line, apex 25.6 m); five stepped gables with crenellated ledges, pinnacles and flagpoles; the NE corner gable (frame of ring edge 12, t -5.4..-0.6, base 21.0, apex 29.4 plus finial) and the turret beside the tower (r 1.15 m) are placed by eye from the 2007 photo. Not modelled: the row of six small dormers on the Marnixstraat roof (roof geometry there is ambiguous) and the SW canal-side roofline.
